from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """A paper in the collection, identified by its title and listing which of the other provided papers it references."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper as it appears")
    references_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers (known from the collection context) that this paper cites in its bibliography or text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
